summary: PDF acquisition from open-access sources. slim() keeps OpenAlex open-access data; migration 005 adds papers.oa_json and pdfs provenance (sha256, bytes, source_kind, license); new app/pdf_fetch.py fetches on demand from arXiv then OpenAlex https links with robots.txt (including Crawl-delay), pacing, one retry, size cap, %PDF check, atomic write; download_pdf returns named failure reasons that the reader now shows; settings gain a contact email used only for OpenAlex mailto; tools/data_probe.py reports PDF candidate coverage. Unpaywall, backend parsing and embeddings are not part of this unit. ADR 0011.
scope_note: Branch feature/pdf-acquisition, on top of fix/probe-stale-seed (1f5ada9). The untracked .claude/settings.json and .claude/worktrees/ are the owner's and not part of this unit.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call and no operation or ceiling changed. New public requests per user-opened paper: robots.txt per host (cached per session) and one to a few PDF downloads; OpenAlex is queried by stored ID only for papers saved before open-access data was kept.
budget_impact.before: download_pdf made one unpaced arXiv request with no robots check, no limits and no recorded provenance.
budget_impact.after: Ordered sources with robots, Crawl-delay, one retry, size cap and recorded sha256/source/licence clue. Zero model tokens.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; tool behaviour only, not recommendation quality

Two separate read-only code-review agents with fresh contexts (same model family as the author, not a human). Pass 1 found 8 issues in 1f5ada9..aba281e; pass 2 verified the fixes and found 5 residual items, which the author then fixed with tests; those last fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.

open_risks: Live OA coverage (owner run 2026-10-04): 9/10 seeds and 200/200 pool entries have a PDF candidate link, but the pool is arXiv-biased and the only non-arXiv seed (Nature DOI) had none; this counts links, not successful downloads. Whether Unpaywall is needed is still open.
arXiv's Crawl-delay is 15 s per robots.txt (read 2026-10-04); its bulk-access and robots help pages timed out and were not read.
Behaviour change: any existing pdfs row with a file on disk now counts as cached without a request.
Superseded by 2026-10-04-pdf-attach-and-landing: attach, landing-page link, browser check, offline and paywall runs are recorded there.
Reviewed by independent agents after this unit; the fixes are in 2026-10-04-review-fixes-and-mailto. A human review has not been done.
